faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I find flight schedules?
faq.a1: You can check the 'Flights' section for detailed schedules and information.
faq.q2: How do I contact the airport?
faq.a2: Go to the 'Contact' section for details and a contact form.
faq.q3: What services are available at the airports?
faq.a3: Services like check-in, shopping, dining, and more are listed in the 'Services' section.
faq.a4: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available at all major airports.
faq.q5: Where can I find lost and found?
faq.a5: Visit the 'Lost and Found' desk or contact airport support.
faq.q6: Can I exchange currency at the airport?
faq.a6: Currency exchange services are available at most airports.
faq.q7: How early should I arrive before my flight?
faq.a7: It is recommended to arrive at least 2 hours before international flights and 1 hour before domestic flights.
faq.q8: Are there facilities for disabled passengers?
faq.a8: Yes, we offer special assistance and facilities for passengers with reduced mobility.
faq.q9: How can I access airport parking?
faq.a9: Parking information is available in the 'Parking' section. Signs at the airport will guide you to the parking areas.
faq.q10: What should I do if I lose my luggage?
faq.a10: Contact the airline's baggage service or visit the lost and found office at the airport.
faq.q11: Can I bring pets on my flight?
faq.a11: Most airlines allow pets, but check specific airline policies before traveling.
faq.q12: Where can I get information about airport lounges?
faq.a12: Information about lounges is available in the 'Services' section or at the airport information desk.
faq.a13: Yes, most airports have charging stations for mobile devices in waiting areas.
faq.q14: How do I report suspicious activity at the airport?
faq.a14: Report any suspicious activity to airport security or staff immediately.
faq.q15: Are there hotels near the airport?
faq.a15: Yes, many airports have hotels nearby. Check the 'Services' section for recommendations.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.body:
The airport provides free Wi-Fi in all the terminals, including public halls, restaurants, and cafés.
It can be accessed from any smartphone or tablet by logging in with a valid email address.

Internet speed can vary depending on your location at the airport. It’s fine for WhatsApp texting and social media, but it’s rarely good enough for Wi-Fi calling.

dutyfree.title: Duty-Free Shops
dutyfree.intro: Listed below are shops offering great airport bargains before you leave Morocco.

atelierM.name: Atelier M
atelierM.desc: Works with Marrakech families and artisans to create clothing and home décor rooted in Moroccan traditions. Many items feature hand embroidery, crafted in the medina by people working from home.

attitude.name: Attitude
attitude.desc: Popular ready-to-wear store with brands like Calvin Klein and Superdry. A contemporary space bringing top fashion labels under one roof.

hudson.name: Hudson
hudson.desc: Known for high-quality souvenirs and distinctive designs — T-shirts, keychains, and magazines with cultural content and polished presentation.

tableDuMarche.name: La Table du Marché
tableDuMarche.desc: Beloved pastry spot at RAK. Fresh on-site baking: éclairs, croissants, macarons, cakes, pies, and breads. Desks and free Wi-Fi for working travelers.

montblanc.name: Montblanc
montblanc.desc: Premium leather goods, jewelry, watches, fragrances — and iconic fountain pens crafted from platinum, gold, or fine woods. Great for gifts.

matsuri.name: Matsuri
matsuri.desc: Japanese cuisine: sushi, maki, sashimi, plus hot dishes like soups, ramen, and udon. Modern minimalist design; private rooms available.

paul.name: Paul
paul.desc: Sandwiches, salads, and snacks with hallmark Paul quality. Breakfast to snack time — don’t miss the famous chocolate bread.

segafredo.name: Segafredo
segafredo.desc: Premium coffee beans with Moroccan pastries for a quick bite. Terrace with airport views; organic and fair-trade options; giftable coffee bean bags.

starbucks.name: Starbucks
starbucks.desc: Wide selection of arabicas and specialty drinks (lattes, cappuccinos, espressos, macchiatos) with vegan options, plus snacks and branded merchandise.

sunCatcher.name: Sun Catcher
sunCatcher.desc: Quality sunglasses with strong UV protection, from classic to modern styles, using modern lens manufacturing for sharp vision.

travelStar.name: Travel Star
travelStar.desc: High-quality luggage and leather accessories — purses, backpacks, and wallets — trendy yet timeless.

victoriasSecret.name: Victoria’s Secret
victoriasSecret.desc: Popular selection of lingerie, accessories, and gifts designed to help women feel confident and stylish.

dutyFree.name: Duty Free
dutyFree.desc: Marrakesh Airport has a dedicated duty-free store in the departures terminal.

parking.intro: At Marrakech-Menara, parking services are split into two main categories:
parking.short: Short-term parking — ideal for drop-off/pick-up: about 5 MAD/hour or 60 MAD/day.
parking.long: Long-term parking — for several days: about 60 MAD/day (discounts may apply for longer stays).
parking.cleaningDesc: Some car parks offer cleaning while you’re away (about 50 MAD for exterior wash, 150 MAD for full interior/exterior).

about.title: About ONDA
about.description: The Moroccan Airports Authority or commonly known as ONDA (Arabic: المكتب الوطني للمطارات, French: Office national des aéroports) is the Moroccan airport operator and administrator. The company's headquarters are in Mohammed V International Airport in Casablanca.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To position Morocco as a leading aviation hub in Africa by providing world-class airport facilities and services.

mission.title: Mission & Values
mission.tourism: Promote Morocco as a tourist destination

history.title: History
history.content: ONDA was established in July 1990 under parliamentary law 14–89. Prior to then, Morocco's airports were administered by the Moroccan Ministry of transport. One year later, ONDA inaugurated Al Massira Airport in Agadir. On 15 September 2003, Abdelhanine Benallou was nominated as the new general manager of ONDA.

milestones.title: Key Milestones
milestones.1990: Establishment of ONDA under parliamentary law 14–89
milestones.1991: Inauguration of Al Massira Airport in Agadir
milestones.2003: Abdelhanine Benallou nominated as the new general manager of ONDA
milestones.2004: Creation of masterplan to upgrade many facilities by 2010

accidents.title: Serious airport related accidents
accidents.content: Although Morocco has its share in aircraft accidents, the number of serious incidents with fatalities directly related to an airport (approach, take-off or on ground accidents) is very low. The total number of accidents with fatalities in Morocco is 19, resulting in 792 deaths. The same numbers for events directly related to airports are 5 and 171, respectively. The majority of the airport related incidents happened long ago, with the last incident occurring in 1986.

development.title: New developments and plans
development.intro: Around 2004, ONDA created a masterplan to upgrade many facilities by 2010. The main projects include:
development.note: Apart from these larger plans, some other smaller changes are planned around many airports around the country.

projects.0: Build a new terminal of 60,000 m² and a total yearly capacity of 10 million people (end 2006)
projects.1: Upgrade terminal 1: general overhaul and upgrade T1 to increase traffic safety (May 2007)
projects.2: Build new cargo terminal of 30,000 m² and 150,000 tonnes/year (2007)
projects.4: New parking facility and transport link

projects.2: Strengthen the versatile side of the movement area

projects.1: New terminal, aircraft stands and transport links (2008)
projects.2: Work on cargo terminal, taxiway parallel to runway, maintenance infra

projects.0: Building new terminal to separate military and commercial activities (2007)
projects.1: Other works, including control tower and national fence
Extend runway, build parking apron, new taxi-way and two support buildings

projects.0: Reshape and extend existing terminal (2007 and phase 2: 2015)
projects.1: Extend plane-areas: general, runway, plane park, vehicle parking
New roads, new ONDA centre, new pedestrian path
